notes: The 2.11 line. Auto-stock rules (Preferences): off by default, set a minimum quality and which ores to keep and new orders pre-fill the Stock switch; a third Stock state, Sell later, with an Inventory strip that sells everything flagged in one go; Inventory can sell hand-added ore; undo on remove. Clearer names: the Market tab is Prices, Codex tabs are Refinery methods and Blueprints; the phone top bar names the screen and the back button returns to the More list; captions on the last icon-only buttons; deletes confirm. Usage data: screen views and feature use only, no names, orders or prices, with a Send usage data switch in Preferences. Notes in the More menu with search, a second fabrication filter row, payout receipts as an image, a blueprint dashboard pin. Update: an older build cannot turn Sell later off on an existing order.
